message.content: {"basis": "The task policy explicitly requires using the dashboard's 'labeled rating-share values' as the evidence source and selecting the category with the highest current labeled rating share. The chart displays specific percentage labels above each category marker: Quality (36%), Price (38%), Design (34%), Support (45%), Delivery (43%), and Other (53%). Comparing these labeled values, 'Other' has the highest share at 53%. Although the 'Design' marker is plotted higher on the y-axis (which appears to be a separate 'Value' scale), the policy prioritizes the explicit percentage labels over the geometric position. Therefore, the promotional budget should be assigned to the 'Other' category." , "option_label": "Select Other"}
